sources.excerpt: Introducing the Bellyacher: A Limited-Edition Distortion Pedal – Bowman Audio Endeavors Skip to content Just added to your cart Qty: View cart ( ) Continue shopping Submit Close search Search Log in Cart 0 items Home Current Endeavors Used Gear Emporium Home Current Endeavors Used Gear Emporium Introducing the Bellyacher: A Limited-Edition Distortion Pedal Regular price $219.00 Sale price $219.00 Regular price Sale Sold out Unit price / per  Default Title - Sold out Error Quantity must be 1 or more Sold out     Adding product to your cart Bowman Audio Endeavors and Frank Iero present: The Bellyacher A word from Frank Iero: In conjunction with the release of XNauseousX, the 10th-anniversary special edition of my first solo record, Stomachaches , my friend James Bowman of @bowman_audio_endeavors and I have released a limited-edition distortion pedal we collaborated on called The Bellyacher ! With art by the incredible Ash Lowe, The Bellyacher is now available for pre-order and will ship worldwide. The Bellyacher is a full-range distortion/sustain monster, capable of your favorite muff-type tones and so much more! Level: Adjusts the overall effect volume. Tone: Controls the EQ sweep. Body: Blends the clipping section of the circuit. All the way down is traditional diode clipping. As you turn the knob clockwise, it blends in LED clipping diodes. Sustain: Controls the level of sustain/distortion of the circuit. Texture: This switch works in conjunction with all of the controls, depending on their settings. It can take the bellyacher from a dying battery sputtering fuzz tone to a full-gain raging distortion! All pedals are hand-built with high-quality components. Top mounted Neutrik Jacks. Powder-coated and printed by the fine folks at Obscura Manufacturing. Featuring custom art by artist Ash Lowe! (@ashlowetattoo) *This is a pre-order. Please allow 3-4 weeks for shipping.
